race.comment: THE QUIET IMMORTAL (4) broke through for a good maiden win at Wodonga when last seen having placed in three runs prior. He was backed as if unbeatable there, sent out the $1.24 favourite and got the job done nicely. He can go on with it now. JENNI INTIBA (9) has had a mid-prep trial since a sound effort at Bendigo last time. Drawn to get back but should be running on. KING INCANTO (10) is consistent without winning, he's another likely to get back and be running on. QUEEN AMANJENA (13) has been racing in stronger company her past few, ending up well beaten in a BM74 on the Heath at Caulfield most recently. Right back in grade today and she can run an improved race.
